description: Defines the enum OpenClawCanvasA2UIAction with nested structs and static methods for handling UI actions, message formatting, JSON serialization, and dispatching status updates within the OpenClaw project.

classes.name: OpenClawCanvasA2UIAction
classes.description: An enum encapsulating UI action handling logic, including nested structs for message context and static utility methods.

methods.name: extractActionName
methods.description: Extracts the action name from a user action dictionary.

methods.name: sanitizeTagValue
methods.description: Sanitizes a string to be used as a tag value, replacing invalid characters.

methods.name: compactJSON
methods.description: Converts an object to a compact JSON string if valid.

methods.name: formatAgentMessage
methods.description: Formats a message string based on the agent message context.

methods.name: jsDispatchA2UIActionStatus
methods.description: Generates JavaScript code to dispatch a UI action status event.
